products.name: True Teak BLEACHED LIGHT RUSTIC
products.backing: Solid Lumber Core, 100% Teak in all layers
products.gloss: Ultra-Matte For centuries, genuine Burmese Teak (Tectona grandis) has been one of the most precious and sought after woods on Earth. Revered not only for its exquisite aesthetics but also for its remarkable resistance to decay, as well as its ability to withstand the challenges of moisture-induced expansion and contraction. Teak has long been the cherished choice of artisans in the realms of upscale furniture crafting, boat construction, and woodworking. Teak’s deep chestnut brown color punctuated by subtle black streaks and unique grain structure make it among the most beautiful woods available. Monarch Plank is proud to offer genuine Teak in an engineered format made with formaldehyde-free adhesive, featuring a thick, 4mm sawn wear layer and a silky, ultra-matte finish. 100% of the wood in our True Teak flooring comes from responsibly managed plantation forests in Thailand. Install Method: Nail-down, glue-down, or float. Warranty Structural: Lifetime | Finish- 25 Year Residential and 3 Year Light Commercial

Collection membership assigned by product TITLE prefix (authoritative) since several /collections/*/products.json returned 0 (manor-collection, premio-collection, tableau-collection, lago-collection) while their products clearly exist in the main feed under those title prefixes. Collections that returned 0 products AND are empty landing pages (alizes, ardeche, bordeaux, diamante, edinburgh, fleur, glasgow, pietra, quadrata, versailles) are listed in collections_failed (each renders 'No products' on its HTML page; the 4 product links there are just nav boilerplate). 'chevron' collection HTML is 404; 'create-your-own-design' HTML exists but no products.json items and is the Custom Parquet Program landing. 'lago-collection' HTML is 404 but Lago products exist in main feed (assigned by title). Herringbone variants of Domaine II & Lago are separate products (own handles) and are grouped under their parent collection. ALL Monarch Plank flooring is ENGINEERED (sawn/dry-sawn top layer over hardwood plywood/lumber core) EXCEPT no true solid; construction hardcoded 'engineered'. EDGE is not stated in prefinished collection specs (only the 4 Unfinished French Oak/Walnut SKUs state 'Square edges'); edge left blank for prefinished, noted 'Square (micro-bevel on some)' where 'square edge' appeared. Extra spec fields captured beyond the requested schema: texture, treatment, grade, backing, gloss. The 4 Unfinished products (prime-european-oak, rustic-walnut-1, french-oak-rustic-grade, french-oak-herringbone) have EMPTY variant SKUs and multi-size TABLE specs in body_html (not label:value), so their width/thickness/etc. fields are blank here — see body for the size table (e.g. French Oak Prime offered 5/8x7, 3/4x7, 3/4x8, 25/32x10; origin France/Burgundy). Nav menu confirms collection nominal sizes: La Grande 25/32x11-3/8, Dover 25/32x7-1/2, Domaine II 3/4x9-1/2, Manor 3/4x9-1/2, Tableau 5/8x8-5/8, Hokkaido 5/8x7-1/2, Regent 5/8x7-1/2, Premio 5/8x6-1/2 or 7-1/2, Vinland 5/8x6 or 7, True Teak 5/8x7-1/4, Lago 9/16x7.
